expectations.text: Identifies NCNICC-1:2025, the Non-CNI Private Sector Entities Cybersecurity Controls, adopted December 28, 2025
expectations.evidence: Never mentions NCNICC-1:2025; analyzes only ECC applicability and says ECC is "not automatically legally binding" on a non-CNI retailer.

expectations.text: Applies size-based applicability: over 250 employees (or over SAR 200M revenue) places the company in Category A
expectations.evidence: No size-based categorization; no mention of Category A, 250-employee or SAR 200M thresholds.

expectations.text: States Category A faces 3 main components, 22 sub-components and 65 mandatory controls
expectations.evidence: No such counts; explicitly says "I cannot confirm from memory the exact control counts or any 2025 to 2026 amendments."

expectations.text: States no compliance deadline has been published and the NCA may assess compliance at any time without notice
expectations.evidence: No statement about a missing compliance deadline or NCA assessments without notice.

expectations.text: Describes the component coverage: cybersecurity governance, cybersecurity defence, and third-party and cloud computing
expectations.evidence: Describes the five ECC-2:2024 domains instead; does not describe the NCNICC three-component structure.
